title: Umugaragu w'ubwenge bwihishe
intro: Mu nkuru nyinshi za Koruni, hari umuntu udasanzwe, umugaragu wa Allah wuzuye ubumenyi n'impuhwe by'Imana. Uyu muntu w'amayobera yahuye n'umwe mu bahanuzi bakomeye, bimuganisha ku rugendo rwuzuyemo ibikorwa bitoroshye byabangamiye aho ubushobozi bw'abantu bugarukira. Buri gikorwa, nubwo cyasaga n'aho ari kibi, cyahishe amasomo akomeye ku byerekeye ibizaza, kwihangana, n'ubwenge butagaragara inyuma y'itegeko ry'Imana. Uyu muntu w'igicucu ni nde, kandi ni ubuhe kuri yahishuye?
clues: Nari umugaragu wa Allah, natoranijwe kubera ubumenyi n'impuhwe byihariye.
Umuhanuzi ukomeye yashatse kunyigiraho, maze ndabyemera mu buryo bukomeye.
Mu gihe twahuraga, nakoze ibikorwa bitatu byasaga n'aho bitamunogeye mugenzi wanjye.
Nangije ubwato bw'abakene, nyamara byari imbabazi zihishe.
Naramwishe umwana muto, nubwo byasaga n'ubugome, ariko byari ukugira ngo ababyeyi be batamubabarire.
Nongeye kubaka inkike mu mujyi watwimye kwakira abashyitsi, nhishura ubutunzi munsi yawo.

arabic: فَوَجَدَا عَبْدًۭا مِّنْ عِبَادِنَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَعَلَّمْنَـٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا عِلْمًۭا
verse: And they found a servant from among Our servants [i.e., al-Khiḍr] to whom We had given mercy from Us and had taught him from Us a [certain] knowledge. (18:65)
